decisive_items: a markedly hypoplastic left ventricle with a severely reduced mitral valve orifice
two great vessels arising in parallel from the right ventricle
response.rationale: The combination of a hypoplastic left ventricle, severe tricuspid regurgitation, and two great vessels arising from the right ventricle points towards Tricuspid Atresia, although some features like the two great vessels are also seen in Tetralogy of Fallot.

rejected.why: Ventricular Septal Defect is a component of the case, but not the primary diagnosis.
